description: Where a TmMobileActionBar anchors. StickyContainer (default) sticks inside the component's own container (position: sticky, never fixed). FixedViewport is a deliberate opt-in anchoring the bar to the viewport with the bottom safe area. Inline renders the bar statically at the end of the content.

values.name: StickyContainer
values.description: The bar is the last in-flow element of its container and sticks to the bottom of the viewport while the container is scrolled through.

values.name: FixedViewport
values.description: The bar anchors to the viewport (both inline edges pinned) and respects the bottom safe area. A host transform/filter/contain on an ancestor re-anchors it per CSS.

values.name: Inline
values.description: The bar is static: it sits at the end of the content with no sticking or fixing.
